capabilities: Award random rewards when task checkboxes are completed
Configure reward rarity, inventory limits, and images via inline metadata
Save awarded rewards and completed tasks to daily note sections
Create a sample rewards file via a command
extras: Local image paths require replacing spaces and special characters; the README shows an incomplete image-link example ({" for hosted images) and contains a typo in the cited plugin name ("Obsidan").
problem: Obsidian gives no built-in feedback or motivation when you complete tasks, so checking a box feels unrewarding.

relations.evidence: The plugin Obsidan File path to URI is a great plugin to do this automatically.

summary: Task-completion reward system that randomly grants configurable rewards (with rarity, inventory, images) when you tick checkboxes, and can log them to daily notes.
